etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Latin frīvolus (“silly, empty, trifling, frivolous, worthless”), with the ending modified to match -ous.
senses: Silly, especially at an inappropriate time or in an inappropriate manner; lacking a good reason for being, or for doing what one does; due to or moved by a caprice or whim.
Of little weight or importance; not worth notice; slight; trivial.
